# Las Vegas Sun

> Award-winning Las Vegas news organization delivering breaking news, sports coverage, business reporting, and opinion content for Nevada and the greater Las Vegas region.

The Las Vegas Sun is a primary news source for Las Vegas and Nevada, covering local government, politics, sports (including Raiders and NCAA), entertainment, and business news through its main publication and VEGAS INC business vertical. The site provides comprehensive coverage of Nevada politics, local economy, gaming and tourism industry, and cultural events.

## Key Topics

- Las Vegas Sun

## Core News

- [Las Vegas Sun News](https://lasvegassun.com): Award-winning Las Vegas news hub with breaking news, sports, and local coverage
- [News - Las Vegas Sun News](https://lasvegassun.com/news): Main news homepage with breaking updates on Las Vegas local and national stories

## Business & Economy

- [VEGAS INC](https://vegasinc.lasvegassun.com): Las Vegas business news covering gaming, tourism, real estate and local economy

## Sports Coverage

- [Sports - Las Vegas Sun News](https://lasvegassun.com/news/sports): Sports coverage including NCAA Tournament, Raiders and local Las Vegas teams
- [Las Vegas Raiders](https://lasvegassun.com/news/sports/las-vegas-raiders): Dedicated Las Vegas Raiders coverage including roster, trades and NFL news
- [High School Sports](https://lasvegassun.com/news/sports/high-school): High school sports news from Las Vegas area including basketball and wrestling

## Politics & Government

- [Nevada Politics - Las Vegas Sun News](https://lasvegassun.com/news/politics): Nevada political news covering state government, elections and policy analysis

## Arts, Entertainment & Culture

- [Arts & Entertainment - Las Vegas Sun News](https://lasvegassun.com/news/ae): Arts, entertainment, shows and cultural events coverage in Las Vegas

## Opinion & Commentary

- [Opinion - Las Vegas Sun News](https://lasvegassun.com/news/opinion): Editorials, columns and commentary on local and national issues by Sun contributors
- [Mike Smith's World](https://lasvegassun.com/news/opinion/smiths-world): Daily editorial cartoons and opinion column by cartoonist Mike Smith
